name: NOT
description: NOT reverses the logic of its argument.
tldr: NOT flips TRUE to FALSE and FALSE to TRUE.

basicExample.explanation: Returns FALSE when A1 > 100 is TRUE, and vice versa.

advancedExamples.title: NOT with AND
advancedExamples.description: Check that NOT all conditions are true
advancedExamples.explanation: Returns TRUE when at least one value is not positive.

howItWorks: NOT simply reverses the boolean value of its argument.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The result is the opposite of the condition.

limitations: For negating multiple conditions, use NOT with AND/OR.

commonErrors.fix: Ensure the argument evaluates to TRUE/FALSE.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: NOT works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Can NOT be used with arrays?
faq.answer: Yes, in Excel 365 and Google Sheets, NOT works with arrays.
